title: G7: Edge decay monitor — detect degrading edge over time
description: Create src/edge_testing/decay_detection.py. EdgeDecayMonitor splits returns into 4 equal quarters, computes Sharpe per quarter, runs Mann-Kendall trend test on quarter Sharpes (detecting monotonic decline). Also Mann-Whitney recent vs historical comparison. Output: quarter_sharpes, trend_tau (negative = decaying), trend_p_value, recent_vs_historical_p. Recommendation: no_decay → monitor_closely → possible_decay_reduce_size → strong_decay_consider_retirement. Most retail traders miss this — they ride degrading strategies to zero.
acceptance_criteria: Quarter Sharpes computed, Mann-Kendall detects declining trend, recommendation escalates with severity

Computes Sharpe, mean_return, win_rate per regime. Shows contribution_to_total per regime. acceptance_criteria: Regime classification maps to known periods (2020=crisis, 2017=low_vol_trending), edge concentration % computed, >70% triggers warning

title: Rollback mechanism — git tag-based deploy snapshots, single-command revert

Auto-tagging: every deploy creates git tag deploy-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS with current lockfile committed. Tags are never deleted (immutable history). Create scripts/tag_deploy.sh: tags current HEAD with deploy-* tag, pushes. Hook into install.sh or deploy script.
acceptance_criteria: Rollback restores exact dependency state from tag, services restart, lockfile diff shows changes reverted

title: Vault agent daemon — in-memory credential server via Unix socket
description: Create src/security/vault_agent.py. Systemd user service. On start: prompts for passphrase (getpass), reads salt from vault.salt, derives key via wolfcrypt PBKDF2 (600k iters), decrypts vault.enc (AES-256-GCM), loads credentials dict into memory. Zeroes passphrase bytes after derivation. Listens on /run/fx-vault-agent.sock (mode 600). JSON protocol: {action: 'get', name: '...'} -> {ok: true, value: '...'} or {action: 'list'} -> {ok: true, names: [...]}. Peer credential check: only same UID can connect (SO_PEERCRED). On SIGTERM: zero credential memory. Exits on decryption failure (wrong passphrase), user retries.
acceptance_criteria: Agent starts, serves credentials via socket, wrong-UID client rejected, SIGTERM zeros memory

Also creates corresponding public key. Include purpose tag support for generating separate keys for different servers.
acceptance_criteria: Key derived deterministically from mnemonic matches on regeneration, QR+hex backup readable, restore writes valid key

Derives vault master key via wolfcrypt PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (600k iterations) from passphrase + random 16-byte salt. Initializes empty encrypted vault ({}) at VAULT_PATH using wolfcrypt AES-256-GCM. Encrypts vault key backup to RECOVERY_PATH with key derived from recovery seed. Prints formatted paper recovery document (passphrase, seed words, SHA256 checksum). Prompts for printer readiness. Idempotent: refuses to overwrite existing vault. Clears passphrase from memory after use.
acceptance_criteria: Generates passphrase+seed, vault.enc + vault.salt + recovery.enc created, paper document prints, refuses overwrite

title: Rate diff mean reversion backtest — 10+ year walk-forward on EUR/USD
description: Create scripts/backtest_rate_diff_mr.py. BacktestStrategy adapter wraps strategy for walk-forward. Runs WalkForwardRunner with CostModel on 2010-2026 daily data for EUR/USD, US_2Y, DE_2Y. Outputs: OOS Sharpe, max drawdown, hit rate, avg win/loss, profit factor, trades per year. Regime-segmented analysis (VIX>25 vs <20, ADX>25 vs <20, rate-hiking vs cutting). Bootstrap 95% CIs on Sharpe. Saves returns CSV, fold metrics CSV. print_summary() for terminal output.
acceptance_criteria: Walk-forward runs 10+ years, produces OOS Sharpe 0.5-1.0, max DD 10-18%, hit rate 55-65%, fold-level metrics saved

title: Strategy 1: Rate diff mean reversion on EUR/USD — Z-score entries, volatility sizing
description: Create src/strategies/rate_diff_mean_reversion.py with RateDiffMeanReversionStrategy class. StrategyConfig: pair=EURUSD, rate_spread_series=US2Y_MINUS_DE2Y, lookback=252d, entry_z=1.5, exit_z=0.3, stop_loss_z=3.5, max_holding_days=30, volatility_target=0.10, max_position_pct=0.20, min_r_squared=0.25. _fit_model() weekly refit via RateDiffModel. _compute_signal() -> deviation Z-score. _compute_position_size() volatility-targeted + conviction-scaled. _should_exit() checks mean_reversion/stop_loss/time_stop. generate_intents() returns OrderIntent list. Quality gate: skips if R² < threshold. Implements Strategy Protocol for walk-forward. Tests: fits on known spread->price relationship, entry at |Z|>1.5, exit at |Z|<0.3.
acceptance_criteria: Strategy produces signals on historical data, entry/exit conditions fire correctly, position sizing respects caps

title: Strategy state store — persistent signal/entry/exit history, crash recovery
description: Create src/strategies/state.py with StrategyStateStore class. Creates strategy_signals and strategy_trades tables (if not exist). record_signal(strategy_id, ts, signal_dict) - JSONB signal data. record_entry(strategy_id, ts, signal, size). record_exit(strategy_id, ts, reason). load_current_position(strategy_id) -> dict or None (for crash recovery — returns last entry if last action was entry). Uses INSERT ON CONFLICT for idempotent writes. Used by both strategies and live engine for state persistence across restarts.
acceptance_criteria: Signals and trades persist correctly, load_current_position returns None after exit, returns entry data if last action was entry

title: Order Management System — intent->orders, retry, partials, reconciliation
description: Create src/execution/oms.py with OrderManager class. OrderIntent dataclass (strategy_id, symbol, target_position, urgency, max_slippage_bps, intent_id). submit_intent(intent): computes delta vs current positions, risk-check via RiskManager, builds orders (market for urgent, limit for passive), places via broker, tracks pending orders. _build_market_orders/_build_limit_orders per urgency. reconcile() compares internal vs broker positions — alerts on mismatch > 1e-6. has_pending() for graceful shutdown. halt_new_trades() sets _halted flag. Thread-safe with _lock.
acceptance_criteria: submit_intent places correct order for delta, reconciliation detects broker mismatch, halt_new_trades blocks subsequent intents

title: OANDA broker — REST + streaming API, FxPractice + FxTrade support
description: Create src/execution/oanda_broker.py with OandaBroker(Broker). Uses OANDA v20 API. Constructor: api_key, account_id, practice flag. BASE_URL switching (api-fxtrade vs api-fxpractice). place_order: MARKET=FOK, LIMIT=GTC. _symbol_to_oanda (EURUSD -> EUR_USD) and _oanda_to_symbol. get_positions: parses /positions response, net_units calculation, avg_price from long or short side. get_account: /summary -> Account. get_price: /pricing -> (bid, ask). stream_prices: async generator over /pricing/stream SSE, yields dict with symbol/bid/ask/ts. get_swap_rates: /instruments for financing rates.
acceptance_criteria: Connects to fxpractice, places market order, gets fills, positions query returns correct quantity, price stream yields ticks

title: Paper broker — simulated fills with cost model, full P&L tracking
description: Create src/execution/paper_broker.py with PaperBroker(Broker). Uses live prices (from self._current_price) with simulated fills, slippage from CostModel. Tracks positions dict, account equity, trade_log list. place_order: fills at bid/ask + slippage, records commission. get_positions: returns Position list from internal state. get_account: Account with computed equity/margin. stream_prices: wraps live broker stream to supply _current_price. Testable without any external connection.
acceptance_criteria: PaperBroker simulates buy/sell round-trip with correct costs, positions tracked accurately, equity equals initial + net P&L

title: Broker interface — Order/Fill/Position/Account dataclasses + Broker ABC
description: Create src/execution/broker.py with Broker ABC and dataclasses: OrderType (MARKET, LIMIT, STOP), OrderStatus (PENDING, FILLED, PARTIAL, CANCELLED, REJECTED), Order (order_id, symbol, side, quantity, order_type, limit_price, stop_price, time_in_force, created_at, status), Fill (order_id, fill_id, symbol, side, quantity, price, timestamp, commission), Position (symbol, quantity, avg_price, unrealized_pnl, realized_pnl), Account (balance, equity, margin_used, margin_available). Broker ABC: place_order, cancel_order, get_order, get_positions, get_account, get_price, stream_prices.
acceptance_criteria: All dataclasses instantiate, Broker ABC defines clear interface, no implementation leakage

title: Scenario stress tester — run strategies through historical FX crises
description: Create src/risk/stress_test.py with SCENARIOS dict (gfc_2008, eurocrisis_2011, taper_tantrum_2013, chf_shock_2015, brexit_2016, covid_2020, inflation_shock_2022, svb_2023, yen_intervention_2024) mapping to (start_date, end_date). run_scenario_stress_test(strategies, data_provider, scenarios) returns DataFrame with per-scenario: total_return, max_drawdown, worst_day, days. Uses walk-forward with no refit (just test the fitted model through the crisis window). Outputs a report: which scenarios were survivable, which would have blown up.
acceptance_criteria: All scenarios run, COVID 2020 produces realistic drawdowns, report identifies worst-case scenario

title: Kill switch manager — 6 automatic circuit breakers with actions
description: Create src/risk/kill_switches.py with KillSwitch dataclass and KillSwitchManager. Six switches: daily_loss_limit (-3% -> halt_new), drawdown_limit (-20% -> flatten_all), vix_spike (VIX>35 and +50% day -> reduce_50pct), fx_vol_spike (CVIX Z>3 -> halt_new), reconciliation_failure (halt_new), stale_prices (>10min -> halt_new). check(context) runs all armed switches, executes action on trigger, prevents re-triggering same switch same day. reset_daily(). _execute_action('flatten_all'/'halt_new'/'reduce_50pct') via OMS. kill_switch_triggered counter for alerting. Tests: each switch fires on simulated trigger conditions.
acceptance_criteria: All 6 switches fire at correct thresholds, flatten_all zeroes all positions, halt_new rejects new intents, daily reset works

title: Regime-aware sizer — VIX/drawdown/correlation multipliers
description: Create src/risk/regime_sizing.py with RegimeAwareSizer class. compute_adjustment(vix, portfolio_dd, correlation_regime, max_pair_corr) -> SizingAdjustment dataclass. Vol multiplier from VIX thresholds: <15->1.0, <20->0.8, <25->0.6, <30->0.4, <40->0.2. Drawdown throttle: >-5%->1.0, >-10%->0.75, >-15%->0.5, >-20%->0.25, >-25%->0.0. Correlation multiplier: normal->1.0, stressed->0.7, crisis->0.4 (×0.5 if max_pair_corr>0.85). Final multiplier = product of all three. reason string for logging. Tests: each threshold fires at correct boundary.
acceptance_criteria: All multipliers combine correctly, extreme VIX+DD+correlation produces near-zero sizing, reason string explains reduction

title: Correlation monitor — detection of regime shifts between strategy pairs
description: Create src/risk/correlation_monitor.py with CorrelationMonitor class. check_correlations(strategy_returns_df, vix_series) -> dict with per-pair CorrelationRegime (current, baseline, zscore, regime='stable'/'diverging'/'crisis', vix_level, recommendation). _check_pair() computes: 250-day baseline corr, 20-day recent corr, Z-score vs rolling distribution. Crisis detection: |z| > 2.0 AND VIX > 25. Portfolio-level assessment: 'normal'/'stressed'/'crisis' based on pair counts. Tests: synthetic returns with known correlations produce correct regimes.
acceptance_criteria: Detects regime shift from 0.2 to 0.8 correlation, flags crisis when VIX elevated, recommendation text actionable

title: Position sizer — volatility-targeted, Kelly, risk-parity
description: Create src/risk/sizing.py with PositionSizer class. fixed_fractional(capital, risk_pct, stop_distance, price) -> size. volatility_target(capital, target_vol, realized_vol, price) -> notional-based size. kelly(edge, odds, kelly_fraction=0.25) -> fraction (test: never negative, never >1). risk_parity_weights(cov_matrix) -> Series (equal risk contribution via scipy minimize). Include position-sizing examples for typical FX scenarios
acceptance_criteria: All sizing methods return positive finite values, Kelly within [0,1], risk-parity weights sum to 1

title: Event backtester — for event-driven strategies with expanding-window thresholds
description: Create src/backtest/event_backtest.py with EventBacktester class and EventBacktestResult. run(events_df, prices_df, config, starting_equity) processes event-driven backtests. Uses expanding-window threshold calibration (percentile-based from past events only). Simulates entries on event day close, exits after holding_days with trailing stops, hard stops, time stops. Tracks P&L with costs + swaps. Outputs trades_df, equity_curve, metrics. Handles edge: events during market closures, overlapping positions (skip if already in pair). Tests: no look-ahead in thresholds, trailing stops trigger correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Event backtest runs on synthetic events, thresholds expand correctly, trailing stop exits at correct level

title: Swap/funding model — daily swap with triple-Wednesday and broker markup
description: Create src/backtest/swap_model.py with SwapModel class and SwapModelConfig (broker_markup_pct=0.50, weekend_roll_weekday=2). compute_daily_swap(pair, position, target_rate, base_rate, day_of_week) -> float. Triple-swap Wednesday (multiplier=3), weekend no charge, broker markup penalty. simulate_position_with_swap() integrates swap into full P&L: price_pnl - txn_cost + swap_pnl over holding period. OandaSwapRates class fetches current broker swap rates for live comparison. Tests: long high-yield currency earns positive swap, short pays, Wednesday 3x verifiable.
acceptance_criteria: Swap correctly positive for carry positions, negative for funding positions, Wednesday 3x, broker markup reduces credit

title: Bootstrap confidence intervals — stationary bootstrap for Sharpe ratios
description: Create src/backtest/bootstrap.py with bootstrap_sharpe_ci(returns, n_bootstrap=10000, confidence=0.95) using standard bootstrap. stationary_bootstrap(returns, block_mean_len=20) using Politis-Romano method for serially correlated returns (FX has autocorrelation). Returns proper 95% confidence intervals. A Sharpe of 1.2 may have CI of [0.3, 2.1] — honest reporting prevents overconfidence. Tests: CI width scales with return volatility, stationary bootstrap preserves autocorrelation better than iid.
acceptance_criteria: Bootstrap CI narrow for consistent returns, wide for volatile, stationary bootstrap CI wider than iid for autocorrelated data

title: Performance analytics — Sharpe, Sortino, max DD, hit rate, profit factor
description: Create src/backtest/analytics.py with PerformanceAnalytics class. metrics(returns) computes: total_return, CAGR, volatility, sharpe, sortino, max_drawdown (+duration), calmar, hit_rate, avg_win, avg_loss, profit_factor, var_95, expected_shortfall, skewness, kurtosis. regime_metrics(returns, regime_series) -> performance per regime. rolling_sharpe(returns, window=63). All annualized where appropriate (factor √252). Handles edge cases: empty returns, zero std, all-positive/all-negative trades.
acceptance_criteria: All metrics compute correctly on known return series, Sharpe ~0 for flat returns, max DD negative, profit_factor >1 for profitable series

title: Cost model — spread + slippage for realistic backtesting
description: Create src/backtest/cost_model.py with CostModel dataclass: spread_bps (default 0.5), slippage_bps (default 0.3). cost_per_turn property = (spread_bps + slippage_bps) / 10000. Include per-pair spread configuration (EURUSD=0.3, USDJPY=0.4, GBPUSD=0.6, USDCAD=0.5, crosses=1.5). Include time-aware spread widening (x2 during news times, x3 overnight). Tests: cost per turn correct for different configs.
acceptance_criteria: cost_per_turn computes correctly, per-pair spreads override default, time-aware widening function

title: Walk-forward runner — non-overlapping IS/OOS windows, Strategy Protocol
description: Create src/backtest/walkforward.py with WalkForwardConfig (is_window_days=756, oos_window_days=63, step_days=63, min_history=756), WalkForwardRunner class. run(data, strategy_factory, cost_model) returns WalkForwardResult (oos_signals, oos_returns, trades, fold_metrics, params_by_fold). Strategy Protocol: fit(train_data), generate_signals(test_data) -> Series. _signals_to_trades() converts signals to position vectors with costs. _sharpe() helper. Ensures no look-ahead (train end < test start verified via spy strategy). Per-fold: train_start, train_end, test_start, test_end, train_sharpe, test_sharpe, params dict.
acceptance_criteria: Runs walk-forward on synthetic data, train/test windows don't overlap, spy strategy confirms no look-ahead, fold_metrics report per-period Sharpe

title: Corpus builder — stratified sampling + active learning for labeling
description: Create labeling/build_corpus.py script. Stratified random sampling across CBs (fed: 30%, ecb: 20%, boe: 15%, boj: 10%, boc: 10%, other: 15%), doc types (statement: 35%, minutes: 20%, speech: 25%, presser: 20%), and time periods (year buckets). Filters: sentence length 30-400 chars. Output: labeling/corpus_v1.csv with sentence_id, doc_id, sentence, cb, doc_type, date, label (empty), labeler (empty), confidence (empty), notes (empty). Active learning module select_next_batch(): uncertainty-based selection using transformer model probabilities, diversity via embedding clustering (KMeans). Randomizes sentence order so labeler sees mixed sources.
acceptance_criteria: Corpus CSV produced with balanced distribution across CBs/doc_types/years, active learning selects uncertain/diverse sentences, ~2500 sentences target

title: Streamlit labeling app — sentence classifier with keyboard shortcuts
description: Create labeling/app.py as a Streamlit web app for labeling CB sentences. Loads corpus CSV and labels CSV from labeling/ directory. Displays one sentence at a time with source metadata (cb, doc_type, date). Three classification buttons: Dovish (0), Neutral (1), Hawkish (2) — with keyboard shortcuts (1/2/3). Skip button (S). Confidence slider (low/medium/high). Optional notes field. Progress metric (N/total labeled). Color-coded guidelines panel. Auto-saves to labeling/labels.csv after each label. Resume support (skips already-labeled sentences). Confidence filtering in final export.
acceptance_criteria: App launches, loads unlabeled sentences, allows labeling with keyboard, saves to CSV, resumes from where left off

title: NLP Airflow DAG — scheduled scraper run every 6 hours + sentiment processing
description: Create airflow/dags/cb_scrapers.py with a DAG running every 6 hours. Task chain: run_all_scrapers (Fed + ECB + BoE + BoJ + BoC in parallel) → preprocess_documents (clean + segment) → lexicon_score (score all sentences, persist to cb_sentiment table) → compute_diffs (for each CB's consecutive statements, compute net_shift, persist to cb_diff_events table) → refresh_materialized_views (update cb_daily_sentiment). DAG skips if no new documents fetched (idempotent). Each task logs document counts processed.
acceptance_criteria: DAG runs, scrapers fetch if new content, sentiment scores persisted, diffs computed for statement pairs, morning run catches overnight releases

title: Statement diff analyzer — redline comparison, net hawkish shift scoring
description: Create src/nlp/diff.py with StatementDiffer class and StatementDiff dataclass (added_sentences, removed_sentences, modified_pairs, added_hawkish_score, removed_hawkish_score, net_shift, raw_diff_ratio). diff(current_sentences, previous_sentences) uses difflib.SequenceMatcher with fuzzy matching (similarity_threshold=0.6). Operates on sentence lists (not raw text) for cleaner diffs. Pairs modified sentences by maximum similarity. Scores added and removed content via LexiconScorer. net_shift = added_hawkish - removed_hawkish (+ = hawkish shift, - = dovish shift). Optionally refines shift with transformer scores on modified pairs. Persists to cb_diff_events table.
acceptance_criteria: Correctly identifies added/removed sentences between statement pairs, net_shift positive for hawkish changes, negative for dovish, persists to DB

title: Lexicon scorer — domain-specific hawkish/dovish term matching and net scoring
description: Create src/nlp/lexicon_scorer.py with LexiconScorer class and detailed term dictionaries: HAWKISH_TERMS (strong: 'additional firming','further tightening'; moderate: 'elevated','persistent','stubborn'; policy: 'raise','hike','tightening'), DOVISH_TERMS (strong: 'rate cut','disinflation'; moderate: 'patient','gradual','balanced'; policy: 'lower','reduce','cut'), UNCERTAINTY_TERMS, INTENSIFIERS, HEDGES. Compile to regex with word boundaries. score_text(text) -> LexiconScores dataclass (hawkish_count, dovish_count, uncertainty_count, intensifier_count, hedge_count, net_score = (h-d)/(h+d+1), intensity = (i-hg)/wc). score_sentences(sentences) -> list[LexiconScores]. Tests: known hawkish sentence scores positive, dovish negative, neutral near zero.
acceptance_criteria: Hawkish sentence scores >0, dovish <0, neutral near 0, intensifiers/hedges counted separately

title: Text preprocessing — boilerplate removal, spaCy sentencizer, ProcessedDocument
description: Create src/nlp/preprocessing.py with TextPreprocessor class. BOILERPLATE_PATTERNS regex list for: release headers, page numbers, long uppercase section headers, implementation notes, 'Last Update' footers. clean(text) applies all patterns + whitespace normalization. segment(text) splits into paragraphs (double newline) then sentences (spaCy sentencizer, min 10 chars). process(doc: Document) -> ProcessedDocument (doc_id, cb, doc_type, date, sentences, paragraphs, word_count, metadata). spaCy model: en_core_web_sm with sentencizer, disable ner/parser/tagger for speed. Tests: known boilerplate removed, sentences properly segmented.
acceptance_criteria: FOMC statement cleaned of 'For release at 2:00 p.m. EDT', sentences split on periods not abbreviations, paragraphs preserved

title: ECB, BoE, BoJ, BoC scrapers — statements, minutes, press conferences, speeches
description: Create four scraper files: src/nlp/scrapers/ecb.py (monetary policy statements/decisions from ecb.europa.eu/press/pr/date/, press conference transcripts, speeches from /press/key/), src/nlp/scrapers/boe.py (MPC minutes from bankofengland.co.uk, speeches), src/nlp/scrapers/boj.py (statements from boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/, speeches from /about/press/koen/), src/nlp/scrapers/boc.py (statements and speeches). Each is a CBScraper subclass. Handle each site's specific HTML structure, pagination, PDF links (skip or extract). All save with appropriate cb and doc_type values.
acceptance_criteria: All four scrapers fetch documents, parse correctly, save JSON with correct cb/doc_type/date, handle missing documents gracefully

title: Fed scraper — FOMC statements, minutes, speeches from federalreserve.gov
description: Create src/nlp/scrapers/fed.py with FedStatementScraper, FedMinutesScraper, FedSpeechScraper subclasses of CBScraper. Statement scraper: list from fomccalendars.htm, parse calendar rows, extract /monetary{date}a.htm links. Parse statements via div#article or div.col-md-8, strip nav/footer/scripts, extract paragraphs, filter 'For release' and 'Implementation Note' boilerplate. Minutes scraper: similar but from minutes pages. Speech scraper: from /newsevents/speech/ listing. Each saves as doc_type='statement','minutes','speech'. Tests: mock HTML responses for known statement dates.
acceptance_criteria: Fetches Fed statements from 2020-2026, parses correct meeting dates, extracts clean paragraph text, saves individual JSON files

title: CB scraper base class — Document dataclass, idempotent fetch + parse + save
description: Create src/nlp/scrapers/base.py with CBScraper ABC and Document dataclass (cb, doc_type, title, date, url, speaker, raw_html, raw_text, metadata, doc_id via SHA256 hash). list_documents(since) -> list[dict] (abstract), fetch_url(url) with tenacity retry and rate limiting, parse_document(html, meta) -> Document (abstract), save_document(doc) -> Path (writes individual JSON files keyed by doc_id). run(since) orchestrates: list -> check if already fetched (by doc_id_stem glob) -> fetch -> parse -> save. httpx client with Mozilla User-Agent, 30s timeout. Logging via LogContext with cb+doc_type context.
acceptance_criteria: Base class structure correct, run() skips already-fetched docs, Document.doc_id unique per URL+CB, JSON files written to raw_dir

title: Cross-asset correlation monitor — rolling matrices, breakdown detection
description: Create src/models/correlation.py with compute functions: rolling_correlation_matrix (returns_df, windows [20, 60, 250] -> dict of matrices), detect_correlation_breakdown (recent_corr, baseline_corr, std -> zscore and regime), detect_correlation_flip (pair correlation sign changes). Monitor key relationships: EUR/USD vs US-DE 2Y spread, gold vs DXY, AUD/JPY as risk barometer, VIX vs USD/JPY. Output regime label (normal/diverging/crisis) per pair. Export to features table for dashboard display.
acceptance_criteria: Rolling correlations computed for all windows, breakdown detection identifies regime shift, flip detection catches sign changes

title: Feature caching — materialize computed features to features table
description: Create a feature caching pipeline that materializes computed features (rate_diff_zscore, realized_vol, cot_zscore, carry, momentum_signal) to the features table. Runs as an Airflow DAG step after ingestion. Uses FeatureStore to compute all registered features for all tracked symbols. Implements incremental updates (only compute since last cached value). Handles missing data gracefully (forward fill, minimum data requirements). Add feature_staleness_seconds Prometheus gauge updated after each run.
acceptance_criteria: All features written to features table, incremental updates efficient (only new data computed), staleness gauge reports fresh

title: OIS curve bootstrapper — from par quotes to discount factors, forwards, policy path
description: Create src/rates/ois_curve.py with OISQuote and OISCurve classes. from_quotes(currency, valuation_date, raw_quotes) factory. _tenor_to_date() converts labels ('3M', '2Y') to adjusted dates. _bootstrap() iteratively solves discount factors at each tenor: single-payment for ≤1Y (DF=1/(1+S×tau)), multi-payment for >1Y using annual coupon dates. discount_factor(d) interpolates via cubic spline in log-DF space (monotonic, positive). zero_rate(d), forward_rate(d1, d2), implied_rate_at_meeting(), policy_path(meeting_dates), meeting_probability(current_rate, move_size=25bp). Tests: round-trip par pricing (NPV=0), monotonic DFs, forward rate consistency.
acceptance_criteria: Bootstraps curve from sample quotes, round-trip pricing error < 1e-6, forwards consistent with zeros, meeting probabilities sum to ~1

title: Feature computation — rate_diff_zscore, realized_vol, cot_zscore, carry, momentum
description: Create src/features/ with compute functions: rate_differential_zscore (us_2y, de_2y, window=252 -> Series), realized_vol (price, window=20 -> annualized), cot_zscore (net_position, window=156 weeks -> Series), carry (target_rate, base_rate -> Series), momentum_signal (price, lookback=63 -> Series), zscore (series, window -> Series). Create FeatureStore class with register(FeatureSpec) using topological sort of dependencies. FeatureSpec dataclass: name, dependencies (list), compute_fn, lookback_days.
acceptance_criteria: All features compute correctly on known data, FeatureStore resolves dependency order, rate_diff_zscore produces stationary series

title: Reaction function model — Fed (Taylor-like) with calibratable weights
description: Create src/models/reaction_function.py with FedReactionFunction class. Parameters: r_star (real neutral rate), pce_target (2.0), u_star (natural unemployment, ~4.2). Weights: w_core_pce (0.6), w_unemployment (0.3), w_fci (0.1). implied_rate(core_pce, unemployment, fci) -> float using Taylor principle (coefficient >1 on inflation gap). fit(historical_data) calibrates weights via scipy.optimize.minimize to match historical fed funds decisions. Include Taylor rule baseline for comparison. Extensible for ECB/BoE/BoJ subclasses.
acceptance_criteria: implied_rate returns reasonable values, fit() converges on historical data, calibrated weights within bounds

title: Rate differential model — rolling OLS regression for currency pairs
description: Create src/models/rate_diff.py with RateDiffModel class. Fits statsmodels OLS: target = α + β×spread + ε on daily data. Configurable window_days (default 756, ~3 years). fit(df) returns dict with coefficients, residual_std, r_squared. predict(df) returns fitted values. deviation_zscore(df) standardizes residuals. Quality gate: min_r_squared threshold. DataReader utility to fetch aligned series from prices and macro_data tables for target pair + spread components.
acceptance_criteria: Fits OLS correctly on synthetic data with known β, deviation Z-scores computed, R² quality gate fires below threshold

title: Business day calendar — holiday-aware date adjustment per currency
description: Create src/rates/calendar.py with Calendar class using python-holidays. is_business_day(d) -> bool. adjust(d, convention) supporting FOLLOWING, MODIFIED_FOLLOWING, PRECEDING conventions. add_business_days(d, n). CALENDARS dict: USD=US, EUR=DE (TARGET2 approximation), GBP=GB, JPY=JP, CAD=CA, CHF=CH, AUD=AU. Tests: known holidays produce correct adjustments, modified following doesn't cross months.
acceptance_criteria: All 7 currency calendars created, July 4 observed correctly for USD, Good Friday and Easter Monday for EUR, modified following rolls back if crossing month boundary

title: Day-count convention module — ACT/360, ACT/365, ACT/ACT, 30/360
description: Create src/rates/daycount.py with DayCountConvention enum (ACT_360, ACT_365, ACT_ACT, THIRTY_360). year_fraction(d1, d2, convention) function computing year fraction per convention. OIS_CONVENTIONS dict mapping currency to convention (USD=ACT_360, EUR=ACT_360, GBP=ACT_365, JPY=ACT_365, CAD=ACT_365, CHF=ACT_360, AUD=ACT_365). Tests: known date pairs produce correct fractions (1 year at ACT_360 = 365/360 ≈ 1.014).
acceptance_criteria: All four conventions compute correct year fractions for known dates, OIS_CONVENTIONS mapping complete for all 7 currencies

title: Airflow DAG — weekly COT ingestion (Friday after 3:30 PM ET release)
description: Create airflow/dags/fx_weekly.py with a DAG scheduled Friday at 20:30 UTC. Single task: ingest_cot which calls the CFTC COT ingester. Configure retries=3 (the report sometimes posts late), retry_delay=30min. After ingestion, compute derived COT metrics (net positions, % of OI, Z-scores per category) and write to features table. DAG should skip if report_date hasn't changed since last run (idempotent).
acceptance_criteria: DAG appears in Airflow UI, ingests COT data on Friday evening, computes net position and Z-score features, skips if no new report

title: Airflow DAG — daily ingestion pipeline (prices, macro, quality checks)
description: Create airflow/dags/fx_daily.py with a DAG scheduled at 23:00 UTC weekdays. Task dependencies: ingest_prices (Stooq), ingest_macro (FRED + ECB + BoJ + BoE), ingest_sofr (CME) all run in parallel → then validate_all (runs all quality checks). Each task calls the respective ingester's run() method. Configure retries=2, retry_delay=5min, email_on_failure. DAG catches ingestion failures and logs them without blocking downstream validation. Pass start_date as yesterday to avoid backfill on first run.
acceptance_criteria: DAG parses and appears in Airflow UI, manual trigger runs all tasks, validate task reports quality results, logs visible in Airflow UI

title: Data quality validation — Great Expectations checks on all tables
